notes.title: Introducing Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237730/Catlateral_Damage_Remeowstered/

[h1]Back with a vengeance![/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237730/Catlateral_Damage_Remeowstered/][i]Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered[/i][/url] is the "mew and improved" definitive edition of your favorite destructive house cat simulator! Rebuilt from the ground up, [i]Remeowstered[/i] offers a completely revamped metagame, new objectives, new special abilities, and more plus all the mischievous gameplay and real-life cat photos you love. Add it to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237730/Catlateral_Damage_Remeowstered/]wishlist[/url] right meow!

[h1]Play during the Steam Game Festival![/h1]
[i]Remeowstered[/i] will be featured during the Steam Game Festival from June 16 to June 22 with a limited time demo! Come watch the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1237730/view/2224162525972576498]developer live stream[/url] on Tuesday, June 16 at 2pm PDT/5pm EDT and ask questions during the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1237730/view/2224162525972578285]live Q&A[/url] on Wednesday, June 17 at 2pm PDT/5pm EDT.

notes.title: Virtual Reality & 1-Year Launch Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.8 - May 27, 2016[/h1]

Wow, can you believe Catlateral Damage launched a year ago? Since then, the game has received several new content updates and tweaks, a PS4 version, and now a [b]VR version for the HTC Vive[/b]! To celebrate, the game will be 50% off from now until the end of the month.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Li_gkrLOLTM
http://store.steampowered.com/app/474720/

The VR version is free DLC to anyone who owns the base game. If you have a Vive, just [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/474720/]download the DLC[/url] and you’ll be able to choose between the regular version or the VR version when you launch the game. If you don’t have a Vive, the DLC won’t take up any extra space on your computer or interfere with your enjoyment of the regular game. The regular game also received a small update that carries over some changes from the PS4 version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7055190/1e90fd7b27f24d8947a090a636508af22f6d6ab9.gif[/img]

As always, thanks for playing and keep on being the best cats you can be! :happynippy:
-Chris

notes.title: Happy Pawlidays!
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.5 - December 22, 2015[/h1]

[img=http://i.imgur.com/2dMeHcR.gif]

A winter holiday update has just been released! This update includes a small new bonus level: the [b]Pawliday Den[/b]! This one-room level contains a large tree that the humans brought in and decorated for some reason, plus a nice warm fireplace and tons of gifts filled with upgrades. And if you look closely, you might just see some snow outside! Oh, and all upgrades in other levels have decorative bows on them for the month of December.

In addition to this new level, there have been several bug fixes (apparently crouching was broken again?!). If you find any more, please [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LEhT4E7ipMZl9ySt_MGmLkxFbvRLvyZTqBBU3DY8-DY/viewform?usp=send_form]report them[/url]!

Happy Pawlidays!
-Chris

notes.title: v1.0.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.4 - October 26, 2015[/h1]

A new Halloween level is now available. Welcome to the [b]Furightful Lab[/b]!

[img=http://i.imgur.com/5La8jAD.png]

I've added a brand new bonus level just in time for Halloween! This level is a basement laboratory filled with potions, science equipment, and other spooky things to swat onto the floor. To access it, look for a Jack-o'-lantern in regular levels (which show up more frequently in October) or select it in Litterbox Mode. Thanks to our friends Jason Wiser at [url=http://www.yayaplay.com/]Yaya Play Games[/url] for creating the furniture and physics object art for this level and [url=https://soundcloud.com/cityfires]Brandon Ellis[/url] for creating another awesome music track!

Along with this level, I've also upgraded the project to Unity 5. This upgrade includes an improved physics engine, so performance should be a bit better when there are lots of objects on the floor (like during extended periods of supermarkat destruction). There are also some lighting differences and other changes, but these should be less noticeable. Although I fixed a ton of bugs related to the upgrade, there may be some that slipped through the cracks. If you happen to see something odd, don't hesitate to fill out a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LEhT4E7ipMZl9ySt_MGmLkxFbvRLvyZTqBBU3DY8-DY/viewform?usp=send_form]bug report form[/url]!

Here are the full release notes:

+ Added a new bonus level: The Furightful Lab!
* Upgraded the project to Unity 5 for improved physics and other improvements.
* Tweaked Objective Mode scoring based on player feedback.
* Updated the soundtrack with the new music track.
* Fixed various bugs.
* Probably tweaked/changed some other small things I'm forgetting.

Happy Pawlloween!
-Chris

notes.title: v1.0.3 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.3 - September 1, 2015[/h1]

Hey everyone!

The latest update for Catlateral Damage is now available! This one includes a bunch of cool new stuff for you to play around with.

First off, I’ve added several new objects to knock over based on other great indie games like [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/275390/]Guacamelee![/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/224480/]Octodad: Dadliest Catch[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/250900/]The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth[/url], and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/265930/]Goat Simulator[/url]. (You can check out all the cameos in [url=http://imgur.com/a/PvtaM]this album[/url].) In addition to these cameos, I’ve also added a new bonus level: the Box Purradise! This level is made up of tons of cardboard boxes and has lots of cat food and toys to swat at. There may be upgrades and power-ups hidden within the different box structures, too.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/JGo8q0v.png]

That’s not all! There are also a couple new features in this update. In Objective Mode, the scoring structure has changed from an infinite stream of levels to just 4 (plus any bonus levels you encounter). Bonus levels now give more points at the end and don’t stop your progression if you don’t complete their objectives. So keep an eye out for those special keys to get some bonus points! You also get bonus points for time left over when you complete an objective. Your highest score after completing all levels is then recorded so you can compete with others.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/sn1xRnB.png]

In Litterbox Mode, you can now select the level type you want to play, rather than just playing the same sequence of levels from Objective Mode without a timer or objectives. (For this reason, Litterbox scores are no longer sent to the Steam leaderboards.) You can also load previously saved levels this way. If you find a level layout you like in either Objective Mode or Litterbox Mode, you can pawse the game and select “Save Level” to be able to play in it again in Litterbox Mode.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/UfxxzOj.png]

On top of all this, the game now has full Japanese localization thanks to [url=http://www.kakehashigames.com/]Kakehashi Games[/url]! You can switch between English and Japanese in the Options menu under the “Other” tab. Of course, this update also includes a bunch of tweaks and bug fixes to improve the overall experience.

And with that, here are the full release notes:

+ Added 23 cameo objects for knocking over
+ Added the ability to save levels from the pawse menu and load them in Litterbox Mode
+ Added full Japanese language localization
+ Added a keyboard shortcut to switch between fullscreen and windowed modes (Alt + Enter)
+ Added a brand new bonus level: Box Purradise
+ Added photos of Sockington and Penny
* Reworked the Objective Mode scoring structure to restrict it to 4 levels
* Changed how scores are recorded on leaderboards: Litterbox scores are no longer recorded and Objective scores have been reset due to the change in scoring structure
* Changed how bonus levels work: they now give more points at the end and you do not have to complete their objectives to progress
* Tweaked some procedural data for object and furniture placement
* Tweaked player movement a bit to make it more precise and make jumps more forgiving
* Improved the UI for selecting screen resolution and quality on the options screen
* Fixed bugs with crouching, rooms with missing doors, miscellaneous colliders, and more

Enjoy!

-Chris

notes.title: New Update Coming September 1st!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on some new content over the past couple of months and will be pushing it all live on September 1st! First up, here's a sneak peek of some new objects that will be showing up in different levels:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LH4RZIF.png[/img]

I'll be showing off more about these throughout August on [url=https://twitter.com/catlateraldmg]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/catlateraldamage]Facebook[/url], so stay tuned!

Along with new objects, there will also be a few new features:
[list]
    [*]New Objective Mode scoring
    [*]Ability to save levels (seeds) and replay them in Litterbox Mode
    [*]Japanese localization
    [*]More bug fixes (crouch bug, blocked room issues)
    [*]Minor tweaks/additions (shortcut to toggle fullscreen/windowed, better UI on options for changing resolution)
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing, reporting issues, and just being a great community! ːhappynippyː

-Chris

notes.title: v1.02 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]v1.02 - June 12, 2015[/h1]

Hey everyone! I just pushed an update last night that includes a bunch of bug fixes, including some for achievements that weren't unlocking, plus some optimizations to help the game run better. Here's the log:

+ Added an option to toggle flashing effects for players who may find power-up and event effects problematic.
+ Added code to optimize level loading and performance.
+ Added a missing UI sprite for the maple syrup bottle.
* Fixed a bug where the "Furiends Furever" achievement wasn't unlocking properly.
* Fixed bugs with navigating the "Edit Bindings" menu in the Options.
* Changed the camera sensitivity slider to allow for slower mouse movement.
* Balanced the timer and dollar values in the mewseum.
* Fixed a bug where completing an event under the effect of a power-up would freeze/crash the game.
* Fixed a couple bugs where multiple power-ups could be collected to permanently max out stats.
* Fixed various bugs with the procedural level creation data.
* Probably fixed some other bugs I forgot.

As always, please fill out a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LEhT4E7ipMZl9ySt_MGmLkxFbvRLvyZTqBBU3DY8-DY/viewform]bug report form[/url] if you find any other issues. And if you're enjoying the game, please leave a review on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/329860/]store page[/url]! The more positive reviews the game has the more fun stuff I can add to it. :) Thanks!

-Chris

notes.content:
[h1]v1.1 - May 28, 2015[/h1]

Hey everyone! I hope you're enjoying the game! I just pushed an update with a few bug fixes.

* Fixed a bug where the Mewseum key wouldn't spawn correctly.
* Fixed a bug where the upgrades on the pawse menu overlapped the options screen.
* Fixed a bug where robots would spawn underneath the piano.

Next, I'm going to be looking into a bug where one of the achievements isn't unlocking properly and one that is not displaying the main menu correctly on Linux. Let me know if you find any other major bugs by submitting a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LEhT4E7ipMZl9ySt_MGmLkxFbvRLvyZTqBBU3DY8-DY/viewform]bug report form[/url]. Thanks!

notes.title: v0.2.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]v0.2.0 - Mar. 3, 2015[/h1]
+ Added the mewseum! (Finally!)
+ Added more objects to knock down, like food items in the refrigerator.
+ Added more cat objects (like cat grass and a cat tunnel) to play with.
+ Added more furniture to the kitchen and bathroom.
+ Added some more wallpapers to the house level that are randomized with the procedural system. Lighting color will also change slightly along with wallpaper.
+ Added events that occur randomly when playing in Objective Mode.
+ Added a high and low value object that is randomized per house. The high value object awards 5x its normal points when knocked down and the low value object awards 0.
+ Added several more cat photos.
* Changed how objectives work. Now, the whole house is open from the start and there is one primary objective and an optional bonus objective.
* Renamed “Normal Mode” to “Objective Mode”.
* Reworked some UI to accommodate new gameplay changes.
* Fixed bugs.
- Removed the leveling-up system.
- Removed some upgrades that didn’t work with new gameplay changes.

notes.title: v0.1.3 Release Notes
notes.content:
Just a small update before the holidays. Let me know what you think about the new jumping mechanics!

[h1]v0.1.3 - Dec. 19, 2014[/h1]
+ Added a cardboard box that transports you to the next house. When you complete all rooms in Normal Mode, it will appear in the bedroom for you to jump into. It is available at the start in Litterbox Mode.
+ Added a few more objects to knock over, including a soccer ball and some toiletries.
* Changed the jumping mechanic substantially. Now you can short hop by tapping the button and jump higher/longer by holding it. Looking up when jumping gives you a much smaller boost than before.
* Reworked the pseudorandom number generation code. It can now reliably generate levels based on seed values (similar to Minecraft or Binding of Isaac) and it’ll be augmented in the future.
* Fixed a ton of bugs with and improved the underlying procedural algorithms in anticipation of adding lots more content.

notes.title: v0.1.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]v0.1.1 - Nov. 13, 2014[/h1]
+ Added a leveling up system. Knocking objects onto the floor awards experience and upgrades (cat toys) are awarded upon reaching a new level.
+ Added a short in-game intro to show the cat you are playing as.
+ Added “Report bug” and “Give feedback” buttons to the in-game pawse menu.
* Changed the end-game screen to say “Try again” if you ran out of time.
* Fixed how background music plays in relation to the player’s mute setting. Main menu music now plays correctly when muting/unmuting in Options.
* Fixed the choppiness with slowmo at the end of rounds.
* Fixed some colliders on furniture and walls.
* Other small fixes and improvements.

[h1]Upcoming Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Indicators for newly accessible rooms
[*]Selectable upgrades from a random set
[*]Better upgrade art (so you know what they are & what they do)
[*]More upgrades!
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mouse cursor is not showing for some players.
[*]Some furniture arrangements (e.g. dresser and shelves) don’t line up well, so the player can become “stuck” between them.
[*]Lower refrigerator shelf is hard to jump onto.
[*]Very rarely, the room objective can be “Get 0”.
[*]“Try again” option when running out of time should rebuild the same house you were playing in. It currently only works the 2nd time you run out of time (and onward).
[*]Checkbox toggles (music, invert Y) on in-game options menu cannot be toggled repeatedly.
[*]Resume button on pawse menu isn’t highlighted by default when opening the menu.
[/list]
